text:
Which statement about electrolysis is correct?
Bromine and hydrogen are formed during the electrolysis of molten lead(II) bromide.
A
B
Metals are formed at the positive electrode.
C
Molten covalent compounds are broken down by electricity.
D
Platinum is used as an inert electrode.

options.label: A
options.text: Bromine and hydrogen are formed during the electrolysis of molten lead(II) bromide.

options.label: B
options.text: Metals are formed at the positive electrode.

options.label: C
options.text: Molten covalent compounds are broken down by electricity.

options.label: D
options.text: Platinum is used as an inert electrode.
